typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MEDICAID_ID as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		DOB as string,
		MEMBER_ADDRESS_1 as string,
		MEMBER_ADDRESS_2 as string,
		MEMBER_CITY as string,
		MEMBER_STATE as string,
		MEMBER_ZIP as string,
		PHONE_NUMBER_TYPE as string,
		PHONE_NUMBER as string,
		FACILITY_NAME as string,
		FACILITY_TAX_ID as string,
		FACILITY_NPI as string,
		ADMIT_DT as string,
		DSCHRG_DT as string,
		DISCHRG_DX as string,
		ADMIT_DX as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT [MEDICAID_ID]       ,[MEMBER_LAST_NAME]       ,[MEMBER_FIRST_NAME]       ,[DOB]       ,[MEMBER_ADDRESS_1]       ,[MEMBER_ADDRESS_2]       ,[MEMBER_CITY]       ,[MEMBER_STATE]       ,[MEMBER_ZIP]       ,[PHONE_NUMBER_TYPE]       ,[PHONE_NUMBER]       ,[FACILITY_NAME]       ,[FACILITY_TAX_ID]       ,[FACILITY_NPI]       ,[ADMIT_DT]       ,[DSCHRG_DT]       ,[DISCHRG_DX]       ,[ADMIT_DX]   FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[IA_DELTA_DENTAL_RESULT_EXT]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> IADELTADENTALRESULTEXT
IADELTADENTALRESULTEXT derive({Copy of FACILITY_NPI} = toString(FACILITY_NPI),
		{Copy of MEMBER_ADDRESS_2} = toString(MEMBER_ADDRESS_2),
		{Copy of ADMIT_DT} = toString(ADMIT_DT),
		{Copy of MEDICAID_ID} = toString(MEDICAID_ID),
		{Copy of MEMBER_CITY} = toString(MEMBER_CITY),
		{Copy of DSCHRG_DT} = toString(DSCHRG_DT),
		{Copy of DOB} = toString(DOB),
		{Copy of MEMBER_ADDRESS_1} = toString(MEMBER_ADDRESS_1),
		{Copy of ADMIT_DX} = toString(ADMIT_DX),
		{Copy of DISCHRG_DX} = toString(DISCHRG_DX),
		{Copy of MEMBER_LAST_NAME} = toString(MEMBER_LAST_NAME),
		{Copy of MEMBER_FIRST_NAME} = toString(MEMBER_FIRST_NAME),
		{Copy of FACILITY_TAX_ID} = toString(FACILITY_TAX_ID),
		{Copy of FACILITY_NAME} = toString(FACILITY_NAME),
		{Copy of MEMBER_ZIP} = toString(MEMBER_ZIP),
		{Copy of PHONE_NUMBER} = toString(PHONE_NUMBER),
		{Copy of PHONE_NUMBER_TYPE} = toString(PHONE_NUMBER_TYPE),
		{Copy of MEMBER_STATE} = toString(MEMBER_STATE)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		FACILITY_NPI as string,
		DISCHRG_DX as string,
		PHONE_NUMBER_TYPE as string,
		FACILITY_NAME as string,
		MEDICAID_ID as string,
		MEMBER_ZIP as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		FACILITY_TAX_ID as string,
		DSCHRG_DT as string,
		DOB as string,
		ADMIT_DX as string,
		MEMBER_ADDRESS_1 as string,
		PHONE_NUMBER as string,
		MEMBER_CITY as string,
		MEMBER_ADDRESS_2 as string,
		MEMBER_STATE as string,
		ADMIT_DT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME = {Copy of MEMBER_FIRST_NAME},
		FACILITY_NPI = {Copy of FACILITY_NPI},
		DISCHRG_DX = {Copy of DISCHRG_DX},
		PHONE_NUMBER_TYPE = {Copy of PHONE_NUMBER_TYPE},
		FACILITY_NAME = {Copy of FACILITY_NAME},
		MEDICAID_ID = {Copy of MEDICAID_ID},
		MEMBER_ZIP = {Copy of MEMBER_ZIP},
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME = {Copy of MEMBER_LAST_NAME},
		FACILITY_TAX_ID = {Copy of FACILITY_TAX_ID},
		DSCHRG_DT = {Copy of DSCHRG_DT},
		DOB = {Copy of DOB},
		ADMIT_DX = {Copy of ADMIT_DX},
		MEMBER_ADDRESS_1 = {Copy of MEMBER_ADDRESS_1},
		PHONE_NUMBER = {Copy of PHONE_NUMBER},
		MEMBER_CITY = {Copy of MEMBER_CITY},
		MEMBER_ADDRESS_2 = {Copy of MEMBER_ADDRESS_2},
		MEMBER_STATE = {Copy of MEMBER_STATE},
		ADMIT_DT = {Copy of ADMIT_DT})) ~> FlatFileDestination
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
